title: Love Ya Tomorrow
overview: A fast-paced, sexy comedy about the conflict between romance and reality. He's a romantic, a gifted fashion photographer who transforms plain women into stunning beauties. She's a realist-an ordinary looking young woman fighting for success in the business world. When these two opposites meet, the sparks begin to fly. Their initial battles lead to encounters of a more erotic kind, with romance becoming reality. A final transformation into a stunning beauty by the photographer leaves our realist more of a romantic, and our romantic more of a realist. For these two, love can't wait till tomorrow!
